evals.name: triggers-on-jump-effect
evals.prompt: make an 8-bit jump sound effect as a wav
evals.expected_output: Fires /retro-audio:sfx. Renders the jump preset, or an equivalent square-wave rising parameter set, with the sfx command to a 16-bit mono WAV. Delivers the file path.
expectations: Invokes the sfx skill, not music
Writes a WAV with the bundled sfx.py
Uses the jump preset or states the parameters in one line

evals.name: custom-explosion-parameters
evals.prompt: explosion sfx, noisy and a bit longer than the default, wav please
evals.expected_output: Fires /retro-audio:sfx. Starts from the explosion preset (noise wave) and lengthens the decay, then renders a WAV. Does not ask a questionnaire.
expectations: Renders with sfx.py rather than describing the sound only
Does not switch to the music skill

evals.name: near-miss-song-routes-to-music
evals.prompt: write a looping 8-bit village theme, about four bars
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /retro-audio:sfx. A loop or theme is /retro-audio:music. Routes there instead of rendering a one-shot effect.
expectations: Does not invoke the sfx skill for a looping theme
